title: Apple Store In-Store Pickup Restock & Telemetry Dataset (v1.0.0)
description: An open CC BY 4.0 empirical dataset of 818 timestamped Apple Store in-store pickup restock transitions (810 closed events; P25 = 20.0s, median = 120.0s, P75 = 422.1s), local-timezone hourly distributions, and 5,259,265 polling check latency quantiles across 31 hub stores in the US, UK, China, and Japan. Exported from public read-only telemetry endpoints published by RestockCheck (https://restockcheck.com/service-report).
